extDesc.message: Hide private info while streaming or recording. Click any element to blur or fill it; the mask persists across scrolls and reloads.
extDesc.description: Short description in the store and on the extensions page (max 132 characters)

enabledTitle.message: Turn masks on or pause them on all sites
enabledTitle.description: Tooltip of the global on/off switch in the panel header

enabledOn.description: Label next to the global switch when masks are active

enabledOff.description: Label next to the global switch when masks are paused

unavailable.message: Not available on this page. Open a regular web page. Tabs that were open before installing the extension need to be reloaded.
unavailable.description: Notice shown when the panel cannot talk to the current tab

originLocalFile.description: Shown in the panel header instead of the origin when the page is a local file (file://)

pickStart.description: Main button that starts picking an element on the page

pickActive.message: Selecting… (click the page, Esc to cancel)
pickActive.description: Main button text while picking is active

manualEntry.description: Link under the main button to create a mask from a CSS selector

editorNew.description: Editor heading when creating a mask

editorEdit.description: Editor heading when editing an existing mask

deleteMask.description: Link in the editor heading to delete the mask being edited

candidates.description: Editor section label: list of candidate selectors

candidatesKeys.description: Keyboard hint next to the candidates label

levelClicked.description: Tab for the clicked element in the candidates section

levelParent.description: Tab for the N-th ancestor in the candidates section

noCandidates.message: No usable selector for this element. Choose a parent or type a selector below.
noCandidates.description: Shown when the selected level has no candidates

fieldTarget.description: Editor field label: whole element or keep part of the text

targetElement.description: Target option: mask the whole element

targetPartial.description: Target option: mask the text except a part

targetPartialTitle.message: Mask the element's text except the part you specify

fieldKeep.description: Editor field label: which part of the text to keep visible

keepPref.description: Keep option: prefecture at the start of a Japanese address

keepHonorific.message: Japanese honorific (様, さん, 殿, 御中 at the end)
keepHonorific.description: Keep option: Japanese honorific suffix after a name

keepRegex.description: Keep option: first match of a regular expression

keepNUnit.description: Unit after the number input for first/last N characters

keepPatternPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the regular expression input

keepUnsupported.message: This browser can't mask part of the text, so the whole element will be masked.
keepUnsupported.description: Shown when the CSS Custom Highlight API is unavailable

regexEmpty.description: Validation message for an empty regular expression

regexInvalid.description: Validation message for an invalid regular expression

regexWarn.message: $ERR$ (as is, the whole text will be masked)
regexWarn.description: Regex validation message followed by a warning

keepMatched.description: How many elements matched the keep rule

keepMissed.description: Appended to keepMatched when some elements did not match

keepNoText.description: Shown when no matched element contains text

fieldMode.description: Editor field label: blur or fill

fieldStrength.description: Editor field label: blur radius slider

fieldSpread.description: Editor field label: how far the blur extends outside the element

spreadTitle.message: How far the blur extends beyond the element. 0 means exactly the element's box. The layout is not affected.

blurHint.message: Setting spread to about twice the strength makes the edges fade out naturally.

blurHintText.message: For partial masks, blur is simulated by making the text transparent and drawing only a blurred shadow.
blurHintText.description: Hint under the blur slider when 'Keep part' is selected

fillParent.description: Fill color option: background color of the parent element

fillParentTitle.message: Background color of the element's parent (or the nearest ancestor that has one)

fillPage.description: Fill color option: background color of the page

fieldScope.description: Editor field label: whole site or this page only

scopeSite.description: Scope option and list badge: whole site

scopePath.description: Scope option and list badge: this page only

persist.message: Save for this site (keep after restarting the browser)

update.description: Editor button: save changes to an existing mask

repick.description: Editor button: pick the element again

repickTitle.message: Click an element on the page again to rebuild the candidates

countOne.description: Badge: the selector matches exactly one element

countMany.description: Badge: the selector matches N elements

kindContext.description: Candidate kind badge: ancestor + descendant selector

stabilityHigh.description: Candidate stability badge: robust against page changes

stabilityLow.description: Candidate stability badge: likely to break

clearAll.description: Link to delete all masks on this site

listEmpty.description: Shown when the site has no masks

listHint.message: Hover to locate on the page, click to edit, use the switch to turn a mask on or off

toggleOff.message: Click to turn this mask off
toggleOff.description: Tooltip of a mask's switch when it is on

toggleOn.message: Click to turn this mask on
toggleOn.description: Tooltip of a mask's switch when it is off

deleteTitle.description: Tooltip of the × button in the list

otherPage.description: Badge: the mask applies to another page of the site

saved.description: Badge: the mask is stored permanently

session.description: Badge: the mask lasts until the browser is closed

keepBadgeHead.description: Badge: keeps the first N characters

keepBadgeTail.description: Badge: keeps the last N characters

footerDonate.description: Footer link to the tip page
